caseName: Seaboard Air Line Railway Co. v. Florida ex rel. Burr
caseNameFull: Seaboard Air Line Railway Company v. State of Florida ex rel. R. Hudson Burr, A. S. Wells, etc. and Atlantic Coast Line Railroad Company v. State of Florida ex rel. R. Hudson Burr, A. S. Wells, etc.
attorneys: Mr. James F. Wright for petitioner in No. 653. Messrs. W. E. Kay, Thomas B. Adams, Frank W. Gwathmey, and Thomas W. Davis for petitioner in No. 654., Messrs. Fred H. Davis and George C. Bedell for respondents.

opinions.text:
The orders of November 23, 1926, denying the petitions for writs of certiorari in these cases are hereby revoked and it is now here ordered that the petitions for writs of certiorari in these cases be, and they are hereby, granted.

See post, pp. 729, 730.
